chartPattern.confirm: a daily close below the ~$89.00 neckline
chartPattern.invalidate: a close back above the ~$100 level, or a right shoulder peak significantly above the left shoulder
chartPattern.explanation: The pattern shows a left shoulder around $93 (late May), a higher head at $118 (early June), and price is currently forming a right shoulder, having declined to the ~$89 level. The neckline connects the troughs around $89.00.
chartPattern.signal: A confirmed Head and Shoulders pattern suggests a bearish reversal, indicating a potential downtrend following the break of the neckline.

fundamentals.name: Atlassian Corporation
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: Atlassian Corporation provides a collaboration software that enables organizations to connect all teams through a system of work that unlocks productivity at scale worldwide. Its product portfolio includes Jira, a project management platform for planning, tracking, and managing work; Confluence, a connected workspace to create, organize, and share team knowledge, documents, and collaboration content; Loom, an asynchronous video communication tool to record and share videos; Jira Service Management, an intuitive service management solution for IT, HR, and other teams; and Rovo, an AI offering that assists teams with its Search, Chat and Agent capabilities. The company also offers Bitbucket, a git-based source code management platform for professional development teams; Compass, a developer portal that provides a unified view of engineering components; Jira Product Discovery, a tool to capture, prioritize, and roadmap product ideas; Jira Align, an enterprise agility solution that connects business and technology teams to align strategy with execution; Focus, a strategy hub for leadership teams; and Talent, a workforce planning app. In addition, it provides Trello, an AI-powered personal productivity tool; and Guard, an app for detecting and responding to security threats. The company has a strategic collaboration with Mattermost, Inc. for the development of Mattermost Docs, a sovereign, self-hosted successor to Confluence for defense, intelligence, and critical infrastructure organizations. The company was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Sydney, Australia.

judgment.summary: Strong growth and revenue metrics are overshadowed by negative profitability and high leverage.
judgment.earningsRecap: Last quarter beat EPS estimates by 31.0%; next earnings date is 2026-07-30.
positives: Revenue growth 31.7% YoY, with analyst estimates for current Q and FY exceeding 49%.
Forward P/E of 14.08 and PEG ratio of 0.73 suggest potential undervaluation relative to growth.
Gross margin of 84.8% indicates strong pricing power on its core offerings.
Free cash flow of $1.58B (TTM) is robust and exceeds total debt.
Analyst consensus is a strong buy with a mean target significantly above the current price.
negatives: Profit margin of -3.5% and return on equity of -19.3% indicate unprofitability.
Debt/Equity ratio of 141.41 is very high, suggesting significant financial risk.
Current and quick ratios below 1.0 suggest potential short-term liquidity concerns.
Operating margin of 9.4% is modest, indicating high operating expenses relative to revenue.

news.paragraph: Atlassian (TEAM) is trading at a significant discount to its analyst targets, despite strong revenue growth and a recent earnings beat. The company's forward P/E and PEG ratio suggest it is undervalued relative to its growth prospects. However, negative profit margins and return on equity, coupled with high debt relative to equity, present a mixed fundamental picture. The upcoming earnings report will be key to watch for any signs of margin improvement.
